source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published paper studies pointwise CATE estimation under Hölder smoothness of the propensity, control regression, and CATE, using localized fuzzy hypotheses and a local-polynomial R-learner; it is not a homogeneity-testing critical-radius result.

The paper explicitly treats zero and constant conditional-average-treatment-effect null hypotheses and develops nonparametric tests under overlap, with asymptotic analysis rather than a finite-sample Hölder minimax radius.
